<div id="atlas-map-page" class="map-page">

    </div>
    <div class="map-field">
      <label for="pm-metric">Circle size</label>
      <select id="pm-metric"></select>
    </div>
    <div class="map-field">
      <label for="pm-media">Medium</label>
      <select id="pm-media">
        <option value="both">Air + water</option>
        <option value="air">Air</option>
        <option value="water">Water</option>
      </select>
    </div>
    <div class="map-field">
      <label for="pm-level">Minimum level</label>
      <select id="pm-level">
        <option value="0">All</option>
        <option value="2">≥ 2 hazard-listed</option>
        <option value="3">≥ 3 high hazard</option>
        <option value="4">≥ 4 very high</option>
        <option value="5">5 known carcinogen</option>
      </select>
    </div>
    <div class="map-field map-field--check">
      <label><input type="checkbox" id="pm-dense"> Dense areas only (≥ 1,000 people/km²)</label>
    </div>
    <div class="map-field">
      <button type="button" id="pm-reset" class="map-btn">Reset view</button>
    </div>
  </div>

  <p id="pm-status" class="map-status" aria-live="polite">Loading the map…</p>

  <div class="map-page__grid">
    <div class="map-panel">
      <div class="map-wrap">
        <div class="map" id="pm-map"></div>
        <div class="map__zoom-controls">
          <button type="button" id="pm-zoom-in" class="map-btn map-btn--icon" aria-label="Zoom in" title="Zoom in">+</button>
          <button type="button" id="pm-zoom-out" class="map-btn map-btn--icon" aria-label="Zoom out" title="Zoom out">−</button>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div class="map__footer">
        <span>EEA IED/E-PRTR v16 · EPSG:3035 · GISCO LAU</span>
        <span>Population: JRC-ESTAT 2021 · Permits: EEA IED 2017–2024</span>
      </div>
    </div>

    <aside class="map-side" aria-label="Facility detail and legend">
      <section class="panel">

          <h2 class="panel__title">Facility</h2>

      </section>
      <section class="panel">
        <div class="panel__head"><h2 class="panel__title">Hazard level</h2></div>
        <div class="panel__body" id="pm-legend"></div>
      </section>
    </aside>
  </div>
</div>
<script src="js/page-map.js"></script>

## Reading this map

Each circle is one E-PRTR facility. **Colour** is the highest hazard level among
the substances that facility reported; **size** is the mass you select. Colour
and size answer different questions: a large pale circle (much mass, little
classified hazard) and a small dark circle (little mass, high hazard) are both
worth a look.

The population layer counts residents of 100 m census cells within 0.5, 1, 3
and 5 km of the facility. It is a model for 2021, it covers the EU-27 plus
Norway and Switzerland (not the UK, Serbia or Iceland), and residents near
several facilities are counted once per facility. The atlas never turns a
missing raster cell into zero people.

Use the query string to share a view, for example:

- [carcinogenic mass, level ≥ 3](map.html?metric=carc&media=both&level=3)
- [only dense areas](map.html?metric=haz&dense=1)
- [a single facility](map.html?focus=24748&metric=carc)

Every row in [Findings](findings.html) links back to this page with the right
year, metric and facility.

::: {.callout-note}
**This map is hazard screening, not a risk assessment.** A dark circle means
"this facility reported substances that appear on a hazard list". It says
nothing about dose, exposure pathways, local meteorology or actual harm.
See [Methodology](methodology.html#hazard-classification) for the level
definitions.
:::
